meta.title: Taro Series demo: a serialized baking blog
meta.description: An eight-part sourdough series with a table of contents on every post, upcoming parts shown as Coming Soon, and a completed pasta series.
meta.author: tarosky

1 : (int) $category['term_id']; /** * 連載の親（series 投稿）を作る。 * * @param string $title Title. * @param string $slug Slug. * @param string $content Content. * @param array $meta Series meta (total, is_finished, finish_at). * @return int */ $create_series = function ( $title, $slug, $content, $meta ) { $series_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => taro_series_parent_post_type(), 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_name' => $slug, 'post_content' => $content, ) ); foreach ( $meta as $key => $value ) { update_post_meta( $series_id, '_series_' . $key, $value ); } return $series_id; }; /** * 連載の記事を作る。日付は現在時刻からの相対（日数）で、未来なら予約投稿にする。 * * @param int $series_id Series ID. * @param string $title Title. * @param string $slug Slug. * @param string $body Body text. * @param int $days Days from now (negative = past). * @return int */ $create_article = function ( $series_id, $title, $slug, $body, $days ) use ( $cat_id ) { $timestamp = time() + $days * DAY_IN_SECONDS; $post_id = wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'post', 'post_status' => 0 < $days ? 'future' : 'publish', 'post_title' => $title, 'post_name' => $slug, 'post_content' => "\n

" . $body . "

\n", 'post_date' => wp_date( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $timestamp ), 'post_date_gmt' => gmdate( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', $timestamp ), 'post_category' => array( $cat_id ), ) ); update_post_meta( $post_id, taro_series_meta_key(), $series_id ); return $post_id; }; // 連載 1: 進行中。8 回中 5 回が公開済み、残りは毎週公開予定。 $sourdough = $create_series( 'Sourdough from Scratch', 'sourdough-from-scratch', "\n

An eight-part journey from a jar of flour and water to a crackling loaf. A new part every week.

\n", array( 'total' => 8, 'is_finished' => '', 'finish_at' => wp_date( 'Y-m-d', time() + 20 * DAY_IN_SECONDS ), ) ); $parts = array( array( 'Part 1: Why Bake Sourdough?', 'What wild yeast gives you that a packet of instant yeast cannot, and what you need to get started.' ), array( 'Part 2: Building Your Starter', 'Day-by-day notes on feeding a starter, from the first bubbles to a reliable rise.' ), array( 'Part 3: Flour, Water, Salt', 'Choosing flours and understanding hydration, with a simple 75% dough to begin with.' ), array( 'Part 4: Stretch and Fold', 'Building strength in the dough without kneading. Timing, temperature and what to look for.' ), array( 'Part 5: Shaping the Loaf', 'Pre-shaping, bench rest and final shaping for a tight, even boule.' ), array( 'Part 6: The Overnight Proof', 'Using the fridge to slow fermentation and fit baking into a busy week.' ), array( 'Part 7: Scoring and Baking', 'Blades, patterns and the Dutch oven method for a dramatic ear.' ), array( 'Part 8: Troubleshooting Your Crumb', 'Reading the crumb to fix dense, gummy or flat loaves.' ), ); foreach ( $parts as $index => $part ) { // 第 1 回は 29 日前、以降は 7 日おき（-29, -22, -15, -8, -1, 6, 13, 20）。第 6 回以降は予約投稿になり「Coming Soon」として目次に出る。 $create_article( $sourdough, $part[0], 'sourdough-part-' . ( $index + 1 ), $part[1], -29 + $index * 7 ); } // 連載 2: 完結済み。連載ごとに目次が分かれることを見せる。 $pasta = $create_series( 'Weeknight Pasta', 'weeknight-pasta', "\n

Three pasta dinners you can make in under thirty minutes.

\n", array( 'total' => 3, 'is_finished' => '1', 'finish_at' => '', ) ); $dishes = array( array( 'Weeknight Pasta #1: Cacio e Pepe', 'Three ingredients, one pan, and the trick to a glossy sauce that never clumps.' ), array( 'Weeknight Pasta #2: Lemon Ricotta Spaghetti', 'A bright, no-cook sauce that comes together while the water boils.' ), array( 'Weeknight Pasta #3: Sausage and Broccoli Rabe', 'Bitter greens, rich sausage and orecchiette for a complete meal in a bowl.' ), ); foreach ( $dishes as $index => $dish ) { $create_article( $pasta, $dish[0], 'weeknight-pasta-' . ( $index + 1 ), $dish[1], -60 + $index * 3 ); } // 連載に入っていない普通の記事も 1 件置き、目次が付かないことと対比する。 wp_insert_post( array( 'post_type' => 'post', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_title' => 'Our Favorite Kitchen Scale', 'post_name' => 'favorite-kitchen-scale', 'post_content' => "\n

A standalone review. This post is not part of any series, so no table of contents appears below.

\n", 'post_date' => wp_date( 'Y-m-d H:i:s', time() - 3 * DAY_IN_SECONDS ), 'post_category' => array( $cat_id ), ) ); // 不要な既定コンテンツを片付ける。 wp_delete_post( 1, true ); // Hello world! wp_delete_post( 2, true ); // Sample Page // 新しいパーマリンク構造と連載アーカイブのルールを反映する。 flush_rewrite_rules();
